tasks.label: Inspect JLS sequential execution
tasks.command: jar tf DLUnit.jar | Select-String 'edu/gvsu/dlunit/.*(JLS|Simulator).*class'; Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IO.Compression.FileSystem; $archive = [System.IO.Compression.ZipFile]::OpenRead('characteristic.jls'); try { $reader = [System.IO.StreamReader]::new($archive.GetEntry('JLSCircuit').Open()); try { $reader.ReadToEnd() } finally { $reader.Dispose() } } finally { $archive.Dispose() }

tasks.label: Inspect DLUnit one-cycle simulation
tasks.command: javap -classpath DLUnit.jar -c -p edu.gvsu.dlunit.jls.JLS | Select-String -Pattern 'public void run\(|public void reset\(|setMaxTime|setClock|setValue|gateDelay|clock|cycle' -Context 3,32; javap -classpath DLUnit.jar -c -p edu.gvsu.dlunit.jls.JLSUtilities | Select-String -Pattern 'Clock|cycle|one|setValue|delay' -Context 3,12

tasks.label: Inspect DLUnit clock configuration
tasks.command: javap -classpath DLUnit.jar -c -p edu.gvsu.dlunit.jls.BatchSimulator2 | Select-String -Pattern 'Clock|runSim|setMaxTime|setValue|cycle|one|ldc|initSim' -Context 2,10; javap -classpath DLUnit.jar -c -p edu.gvsu.dlunit.jls.JLS | Select-String -Pattern 'setRegister\(' -Context 0,100

tasks.label: Inspect DLUnit simulation timing controls
tasks.command: javap -classpath DLUnit.jar edu.gvsu.dlunit.DLUnitCore edu.gvsu.dlunit.jls.JLS edu.gvsu.dlunit.jls.BatchSimulator2 edu.mtu.cs.jls.sim.BatchSimulator edu.mtu.cs.jls.elem.Clock; javap -classpath DLUnit.jar -c -p edu.gvsu.dlunit.jls.JLS | Select-Object -First 150; javap -classpath DLUnit.jar -c -p edu.gvsu.dlunit.jls.TestGenFromUnitTest

tasks.label: Inspect JLS public timing API
tasks.command: javap -classpath DLUnit.jar edu.mtu.cs.jls.sim.Simulator edu.mtu.cs.jls.Circuit edu.mtu.cs.jls.elem.Register; javap -classpath DLUnit.jar -c edu.mtu.cs.jls.elem.Clock | Select-String -Pattern 'initSim\(' -Context 0,90
